flipToBack.prose: Collect your senators AT Galactic Senate (Filters.filterActive with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE). Flip if that collection has >= 3 senators, OR >= 2 senators with at least one of them having a blockade agenda.

children.req: count of your senators at location: >= 3 cards in Filters.filterActive(...) collection
count of your senators at location: >= 2
agenda-state within that senator collection: at least one has a blockade agenda

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you have FEWER than 2 senators at Galactic Senate (cannot spot 2 of your senators at Galactic Senate; spot includes battle-excluded).

children.req: count-spot: at least 2 of your senators at Galactic Senate

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: 'with <actor> there' presence-count semantics: Filters.at(Filters.Galactic_Senate) presence of YOUR cards matching Filters.senator; NOT control or occupy of the location. Opponent presence at the Senate is irrelevant to the flip.
Alternative branch: same presence-count at 2 plus an agenda-state check (Filters.blockade_agenda spotted among those senators).
flipToFront: negated count-spot: fewer than 2 your senators at Galactic Senate. Maintaining 2+ senators there holds the back.

NOTE: engine filter is Filters.senator; project memory says only 29 of 35 senator cards carry Keyword.SENATOR (others say 'senator' only in lore). Whether Filters.senator covers lore-only senators is an engine-filter question that matters for AI planning against this law.
typedIdentities: Filters.stackedOn(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Political_Effect)) (may deploy as if from hand)
Filters.and(active, Filters.character, Filters.not(Filters.Republic_character), Filters.at(Filters.Galactic_Senate)) (game text canceled)
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, required): deploy Galactic Senate from Reserve Deck: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Galactic_Senate, true, false) [Card12_179.java:61-67]

START OF GAME (front, required): deploy any other [Episode I] location: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.location, Filters.not(Filters.Galactic_Senate)), true, false) [Card12_179.java:68-74]

BACK, once per turn: take a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle: TakeCardIntoHandFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Political_Effect, true), GameTextActionId.I_WILL_MAKE_IT_LEGAL__UPLOAD_POLITICAL_EFFECT [Card12_179_BACK.java:106-122]

seedMismatches: Terminology only: seed calls both directions' relation PRESENT; source uses Filters.at(Filters.Galactic_Senate) inside filterActive/canSpot ('at' semantics, spot-based counting). Thresholds, actors, and site all match source.

profileGaps: flipGateSite is null even though the flip law has a single unambiguous gate site (Galactic Senate); keySiteFilter='Galactic_Senate' partially compensates.
Count thresholds not encoded: 3 senators, or 2 senators when one has a blockade agenda; the blockade-agenda alternative has no representation (keyCharacterFilter is just 'senator').
flipGateCardIds empty: Galactic Senate blueprint ids (12_167, 12_75) exist only inside objectiveNamedLocations.
Back-side hold requirement (keep >= 2 senators at Senate or flip back) is only implicitly covered by the keyChar/keySite weights; the numeric threshold is absent.
Back-side Political Effect Reserve-Deck tutor is not in pullableCards (empty).
